title: How to Install the Approved Bluetooth Driver
overview: This draft supports the “Install the Approved Bluetooth Driver” step in the Bluetooth Device Not Connecting workflow. It explains the intended check, safe execution, and the evidence to capture before continuing.
checklist: Save open work and confirm the computer model and Windows version.
Check Windows Update for available driver updates.
If necessary, open Device Manager, expand Bluetooth, right-click the Bluetooth adapter, and select Update driver.
If Windows cannot locate an appropriate driver, use the computer manufacturer’s official support site and confirm the exact model.
Install only the approved matching driver and restart Windows if requested. Return to the workflow and test the Bluetooth connection again.
common_indicators: The Bluetooth adapter is missing from Device Manager.
Device Manager displays a warning symbol or error code.
Pairing repeatedly fails despite the device being charged and discoverable.
The installed driver is outdated, disabled, or corrupted.

quiz.question: What should you do after completing this troubleshooting step?
answers: The exact computer model and Windows version

quiz.correct_answer: The exact computer model and Windows version
